Title: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience**

**Department:** Customer Service / Operations  
**Industry:** Car Rental – UAE  
**Reporting To:** Operations Head  
**Location:** UAE

**1. Job Purpose**

To oversee and manage all customer complaints, escalations, customer feedback, and online reviews across the company's car rental operations in the UAE.

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring that all customer concerns received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, messages, social media platforms, and online review portals are properly investigated, addressed, and resolved within the defined turnaround time.

The role requires close coordination with the Operations Head and relevant departments to conduct fair case investigations, identify the root cause of complaints, prepare case studies, recommend corrective actions, and improve overall customer satisfaction and service standards.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Complaint Management & Resolution**

* Take ownership of all customer complaints and escalations received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, SMS, social media, and other communication channels.
* Ensure every complaint is properly registered, categorized, assigned, tracked, and closed within the agreed turnaround time.
* Handle escalated customer cases professionally, ensuring timely communication and appropriate resolution.
* Investigate complaints related to vehicle condition, breakdowns, replacement delays, delivery and collection, billing, deposits, refunds, traffic fines, Salik, accident claims, insurance, rental agreements, and customer service.
* Ensure customers receive regular updates until their concerns are fully resolved.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to avoid delays and ensure accountability.

**B. Online Reviews & Reputation Management**

* Monitor and manage customer reviews across Google Reviews and other relevant online platforms.
* Respond professionally to positive and negative customer reviews within the defined response time.
* Investigate negative reviews and coordinate with the concerned departments to establish the facts before providing a response.
* Ensure no complaint or negative review remains unattended.
* Identify recurring negative feedback and recommend improvements to the Operations Head.
* Maintain a professional brand image and improve the company's online reputation.
* Follow up with customers after successful complaint resolution and encourage genuine customer feedback.

**C. Fair Case Investigation & Case Studies**

* Conduct a fair and unbiased investigation for every escalated complaint.
* Collect supporting documents, call recordings, WhatsApp conversations, emails, rental agreements, vehicle inspection reports, photographs, invoices, and system records wherever applicable.
* Prepare a detailed case study covering:
* Customer complaint and issue summary.
* Date and time of the incident.
* Background and rental agreement details.
* Investigation findings and supporting evidence.
* Department or process involved.
* Root cause of the complaint.
* Company's responsibility, where applicable.
* Proposed resolution and corrective action.
* Discuss all major and sensitive cases with the Operations Head before concluding the matter.
* Ensure resolutions are fair, transparent, and aligned with company policies, rental agreements, and applicable UAE regulations.
* Maintain proper documentation of the final decision and customer communication.

**D. Coordination with Operations & Other Departments**

* Work closely with the Operations Head, branch managers, fleet, workshop, dispatch, delivery and collection, finance, insurance, and sales teams.
* Obtain factual feedback from concerned departments before making commitments to customers.
* Escalate cases involving financial exposure, compensation, refunds, service failures, or reputational risks to the Operations Head.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented by the responsible departments.
* Follow up on pending actions until closure.
* Highlight operational gaps affecting customer satisfaction and recommend process improvements.

**E. Customer Communication & Service Standards**

* Ensure all customer interactions through incoming and outgoing calls, WhatsApp, emails, SMS, and online platforms are handled professionally.
* Establish consistent communication standards for the customer service team.
* Ensure customers are treated respectfully, irrespective of the nature of their complaints.
* Monitor the quality of responses and ensure accurate information is communicated.
* Handle difficult customers and high-priority escalations with professionalism.
* Ensure no incorrect commitments, unauthorized compensation, or policy deviations are communicated to customers.

**F. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly complaint reports.
* Maintain a complaint tracker with status, responsible department, aging, resolution, and closure remarks.
* Monitor complaint turnaround time and unresolved cases.
* Prepare monthly analysis of online ratings, negative reviews, complaint categories, and recurring issues.
* Identify departments with repeated service failures and highlight them to the Operations Head.
* Present improvement recommendations based on customer feedback and case investigation findings.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

Complaint acknowledgement

Within 15–30 minutes during working hours

Initial investigation

Within 24 hours

Complaint resolution

Target 90% within agreed TAT

Online review response

100% within 24 hours

Critical complaint escalation

Immediate escalation

Case study preparation

100% for major and escalated cases

Customer follow-up

100% for resolved escalated cases

Complaint documentation

100% accurate and updated

Recurring complaint analysis

Monthly

Customer satisfaction

Continuous improvement in customer feedback

Pending complaint monitoring

Daily follow-up with concerned departments

**4. Authority & Escalation Matrix**

* Responsible for managing and investigating all customer complaints.
* Authorized to coordinate directly with all departments for information and resolution.
* Responsible for recommending goodwill gestures, compensation, and service recovery, subject to approval.
* Must obtain Operations Head approval before committing to financial compensation, exceptional refunds, or policy deviations.
* Must escalate serious customer disputes, legal notices, regulatory matters, safety-related complaints, and high-risk online reviews immediately.
* Responsible for presenting major case studies and obtaining management direction before closing sensitive cases.

**5. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in customer service or complaint management, preferably in the UAE car rental, automotive, or hospitality industry.
* Strong understanding of UAE car rental operations, rental agreements, insurance, deposits, refunds, fines, Salik, vehicle delivery, and customer service procedures.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Knowledge of Arabic, Hindi, or other commonly used languages in the UAE is an advantage.
* Strong complaint-handling, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to investigate cases objectively and prepare detailed reports.
* Experience managing Google Reviews and social media customer feedback.
* Good knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Excel, and customer service reporting.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage escalations independently.

**6. Overall Accountability**

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be accountable for ensuring that every customer complaint receives proper attention, investigation, and a fair resolution.

The position is not limited to responding to customers or managing online reviews. It requires taking ownership of the complete complaint lifecycle, identifying operational failures, conducting fair case studies, coordinating with the Operations Head, and ensuring that corrective actions are implemented to prevent similar issues from recurring.

**The ultimate objective is to protect the company's reputation, improve customer satisfaction, reduce recurring complaints, and establish accountability across all operational departments.**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

**Reliability**

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

**OUR VALUES**

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

**Be Customer Obsessed —**
Every decision in service of the customer's success.

**Speak & Act Courageously —**
Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas.

**Take Extreme Ownership —**
Nothing is someone else's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability.

**Learn Voraciously —**
Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Move with Focus & Urgency —**
Identify the highest-impact work and move fast.

**Win as One Team —**
Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

*We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.*

*If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.*

Title: Systems Administrator
Description:
The Metropolitan Transportation Commission (MTC) is the transportation planning, financing, and coordinating agency for the nine-county San Francisco Bay Area. MTC is the federally designated Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) and the state designated Regional Transportation Planning Agency (RTPA) for the nine-county San Francisco Bay Area. MTC provides services to the Association of Bay Area Governments (ABAG). For more information about MTC, visit www.mtc.ca.gov .  
  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

The Metropolitan Transportation Commission is an equal-opportunity, non-discriminatory employer. MTC provides all employees and applicants with an equal opportunity in every aspect of the employment experience regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, physical handicap, medical condition or marital status.

  

**DEADLINE TO APPLY IS SUNDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2026, AT 11:55 PM**

**IF YOU ARE INTERESTED, PLEASE APPLY IMMEDIATELY**

*A resume is required with your application*

*Be ready to rethink your assumptions about the public sector. Dedicated and motivated colleagues? Beautiful, high amenity building for on-site work and collaboration? Flexible schedules and hybrid work options? Yes, yes, and yes!*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Under the direction of the Bay Area Toll Authority (BATA) Information Technology Manager, the Systems Administrator provides server, identity, email, and security administration in a primarily Windows Server and Azure environment with a small number of Linux systems. This is a broad role supporting multiple sites, with an emphasis on identity, security, and automation. The position will help build a new configuration standards and automation program and will support facility monitoring technology as new toll facilities come online. This is one of two systems administrator positions on a small IT infrastructure team within the Capital Delivery, Asset Management, and Roadside Tolling (CART) section, alongside network engineers and a technical project manager. Responsibilities are divided between the two administrators and reviewed as the work changes.

The systems supported by this position keep toll collection running across the Bay Area’s state-owned toll bridges and several of the region’s express lane corridors, including equipment at toll plazas and roadside facilities. Because tolling runs around the clock, planned maintenance is sometimes scheduled outside business hours. Unplanned after-hours response is limited to major system failures and security incidents; these have been rare, and the team has not needed a rotating on-call schedule.

  

Systems Administrator responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Administering identity and access platforms, including Active Directory, Entra, and Okta; managing account lifecycle, group membership, and multifactor authentication administration
* Developing configuration standards, building automated compliance auditing against those standards, and maintaining systems infrastructure documentation
* Administering endpoint security and file integrity monitoring platforms; performing vulnerability remediation and system hardening
* Administering on-premises and cloud server infrastructure, storage, operating systems, and system software, including supporting migration of services to Azure
* Monitoring system performance, capacity, availability, and security, and responding promptly to alerts and incidents
* Managing patch and update cycles across the server and endpoint estate, and tracking platform lifecycle to plan replacement of systems approaching vendor end of support
* Administering backup and recovery services, including backup design and scheduling, periodic restore testing and verification, and recovery documentation
* Supporting facility technology systems as new toll facilities come online, including building management, environmental monitoring, camera and video, and physical access control
* Supporting agency technology projects through infrastructure and security design review, requirements input, and technical coordination with vendors
* Performing occasional maintenance outside business hours, providing after-hours response for major system failures and security incidents, and performing occasional on-site work at toll plazas and roadside facilities
* Communicating technical issues clearly, verbally and in writing, to technical staff, vendors, and non-technical stakeholders
* Performing other job-related tasks and duties as needed or assigned by the Section

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Experience administering Windows Server in an enterprise environment, including virtualized infrastructure, patching, and troubleshooting operating system and application issues
* Experience administering enterprise identity platforms such as Okta or Entra, including hybrid integration with on-premises Active Directory
* Experience with system hardening and configuration baselines
* Proficiency with Microsoft PowerShell for system administration and automation
* Experience administering Microsoft Azure
* Experience administering enterprise backup and recovery, including restore testing and verification
* Fundamental understanding of networking, including routing, switching, and firewalls
* Fundamental understanding of common protocols (such as, but not limited to, LDAP, SMTP, TCP/IP, RADIUS, DNS, DHCP, SAML, and SSL/TLS)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, evidenced by a history of enhancing system performance and resolving complex technical issues
Valid California Class C driver's license and a safe driving record. This position requires occasional travel to toll plazas and roadside facilities, which are not served by public transit. Rental vehicles are available for planned site work; the position requires the ability to reach a site on short notice for unplanned or emergency response.  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience** : Equivalent to completion of the twelfth (12th) grade and five (5) years of increasingly responsible experience conducting needs and systems analysis and planning, design, development, implementation, configuration, and maintenance of information technology applications, systems, and/or infrastructure.

**Licenses or Certificates** : Valid California Class C driver's license and a safe driving record.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience** :

* Experience with configuration management tooling such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef
* Experience using version control (Git) for infrastructure documentation or automation code
* Experience with vulnerability management tooling and remediation workflows
* Security certifications such as Security+, GSEC, or CISSP
* Experience administering Linux systems
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Splunk, or similar)
* Experience with operational technology or building systems (building management, environmental monitoring, or physical security platforms)
* Experience with Nutanix
* Experience with LAN hardware including patch panels, switches, fiber optics, and Ethernet wiring
* Experience responding to security incidents and alerts from endpoint detection or SIEM platforms

Title: Technical Support Analyst
Description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Two to four years of experience in desktop support or a related field, with proficiency in Windows and Mac operating systems and common business software applications

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, and Outlook), and Windows installer and desktop management suites such as Intune and Autopilot

* Working knowledge of Mac OS and functionality in an enterprise environment

* Experience in computer and peripheral hardware replacement and repair, including configuring, installing, supporting, troubleshooting, and repairing client workstations, printers, mobile devices, audio, video, and office equipment

* Working knowledge of Audio-Visual technologies and mobile technology, including Android and iOS

* Understanding of network protocols including DNS, Cisco Telephony, and equipment such as routers and switches; working knowledge of enterprise-level networking, troubleshooting, and cloud services including AWS, Azure, and Teams

* Strong communication and customer service skills; known as a motivated team player who can work with minimal supervision and demonstrate accountability and sound judgement

* Ability to complete all tasks and projects in a timely manner within established SLA timeframes, including incidents, tasks, and other workflows

* Demonstrated willingness to go beyond normal job requirements; available to work after hours and weekends to assist with BAU, MOPs, and outages where required (FTE only)

* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

**Education**

* Associate degree in a related field or equivalent experience

**Responsibilities**

The Technical Support Analyst provides technical services to internal customers by identifying, prioritising, and confirming the resolution of reported problems within specified service level agreements, ensuring that TSG values are demonstrated in all daily activities to meet business needs.

* Facilitate problem-solving and collaboration; provide local and remote technical support to Moody's associates using Microsoft Office, Microsoft Outlook, VPN software, and various proprietary applications in a Mac OS and Windows 11 environment

* Configure, install, support, troubleshoot, and repair client workstations, printers, mobile devices, audio, video, and office equipment

* Recognise problem areas, develop proactive solutions, and comply with IT operational performance metrics and service level agreements

* Conduct themselves maturely and professionally towards users and colleagues, demonstrating accountability, sound judgement, and timely follow-up on all support interactions

* Frequently interact with supervisors, functional peer group managers, and customers on matters across functional areas, company divisions or units, and business technology needs

**About the Team**

With 400 employees and 800 contractors worldwide, Moody's Technology Services Group (TSG) is the largest department of Moody's Shared Services. It provides end-to-end technology solutions for Moody's Investors Service and Moody's Shared Services, as well as infrastructure for Moody's Analytics. The development and ongoing support of key ratings and enterprise systems ensure the company's premier standing among credit rating agencies and enable its evolution in line with regulatory and business demands. TSG continuously seeks talented individuals to drive the execution of its technology roadmap, offering exciting career opportunities in programme management, business analysis, enterprise architecture, software development, quality assurance, IT risk management, vendor management, technology operations, and service management.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Title: Senior Technical Marketing, and Application Engineer
Description:
Movandi has made a big impact on 5G in a short amount of time — from foundational research and innovative modular, high efficiency mmWave system design to the introduction of our BeamXR 5G system that delivers improvements in performance, coverage, and latency to connect 5G everywhere. Now more than ever, 5G--supported by Movandi technology--is becoming an integral part of the telecommunications landscape. And we're only getting started.
  
  
We are looking for exceptional leaders to join our team and our exciting journey. We are looking for highly creative, entrepreneurial sales managers to lead our service provider and carrier sales in the Saudi Arabia. and help shape the future of wireless services there.
  
  
In this role you will work with executives, technology specialists and procurement teams in carrier accounts to identify and create opportunities related to 5G infrastructure deployments and wireless services. You will create sales targets, identify channel and technology partners and manage day to day account level activities to drive sales and awareness around our breakthrough technology.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
A key part of this role will include interfacing directly with customers in the Middle East geographic region. In this role you will be interfacing with executives, technology specialists and procurement teams, providing a technical marketing role — identifying and understanding customer challenges and how to best apply Movandi's unique solutions. You will be leveraging your extensive technical background and strong communications skills to act as a translator between engineering and customers. Specific responsibilities include:
  
  

* Giving presentations on Movandi technology, case studies, and technology whitepapers
* Following up with customers questions
* Translating complex product features into compelling and understandable messages for technical buyers
* Understand market dynamics, competitors and bring back to Movandi greater understanding of the customer needs

**Required Qualifications**

* BS with + 15 years of experience, or MS + 13 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field 8–12+ years of experience in wireless communications, with a strong mix of technical and customer-facing roles
* Proven experience in technical marketing, product marketing, systems engineering, or solution architecture
* Deep understanding of wireless communication systems, such as: 5G NR, satellite communication, Wi-Fi
* Experience working with chipsets, modules, radios, or network equipment
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear value propositions for customers, partners, and executives
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

* Ethics
* Trust
* Collaboration

**Key Accountabilities**

**The post holder will:**

* Always speak up if safety is a concern
* Treat all patients with kindness, respect and compassion
* Recognize and work within the limits of their own competence
* Take responsibility for their own actions
* Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure patients receives the safest, most effective care possible
* Perform additional duties when required

* Please refer to Federal Law No. 3 of 2016 (Wadeema’s Law)

  **https://www.khda.gov.ae/CMS/WebParts/TextEditor/Documents/Children\_Law\_English.pdf**

* Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
* Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures.
* Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety.
* Assist with the preparation of risk assessments.
* Report OSH Hazards, incidents, near misses and issues.
* Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible.
* Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
* Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained.

**National Nursing Practice Standards RN MOHAP.pdf**

**Scope of Practice RN MOHAP.pdf**

* Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members.
* Assess and identify patients' needs and implement and monitor the patient's medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings.
* Perform systematic patient assessment, re-assessment and collect pertinent data about the patient’s health or situation.
* Understand and analyse the assessment information and data.
* Determine actual and potential nursing diagnoses, problems, and issues.
* Define the predicted and expected outcomes of the patient’s planned care.
* Create and evaluate patient care plans with the interprofessional team, in collaboration with the patient and patient's bystanders.
* Record vital signs, recognize, address and escalate all abnormalities.
* Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to nursing practice.
* Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment.
* Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations.
* Perform essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation etc.
* Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment.
* Administer medications and monitor patients for any side effects and reactions.
* Administer treatments such as IV fluids or blood products and monitor patients for any reactions.
* Provide wound care management.
* Assist in medical procedures invasive or non-invasive as needed.
* Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge.

Title: Claims Officer
Description:

-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: Legal Counsel (12 to 18 month Contract Fixed Term OR Secondment)
Description:
DepartmentFixed Term (Fixed Term), Full timeClosing Date: November 29, 2026

The Ontario Securities Commission (OSC) is the statutory body responsible for regulating Ontario’s capital markets in accordance with the mandate established in the provincial Securities Act and the Commodity Futures Act. The mandate of the OSC is to provide protection to investors from unfair, improper or fraudulent practices, to foster fair, efficient and competitive capital markets and confidence in the capital markets, to foster capital formation, and to contribute to the stability of the financial system and the reduction of systemic risk. This mandate is performed through policy, operational, and enforcement activities. The OSC also contributes to national and global securities regulation development.

We offer a diverse, fair, and flexible work environment and take pride in our challenging and rewarding work.

***12 to 18 month Contract Fixed Term OR Secondment***
======================================================

  

Reporting to the Head of Growth Markets and Innovation Capital in the Office of Economic Growth and Innovation (OEGI), the Legal Counsel will draw upon legal and/or operational experience to advance the OSC’s mandate to foster fair, efficient and competitive capital markets and capital formation, and Goal 5 of the OSC Strategic Plan: to foster conditions for capital formation and innovation in both public and private markets. The Legal Counsel will work with innovative businesses navigating the OSC’s regulatory framework, help design and deliver tests of new products, services and regulatory approaches, and contribute legal and policy analysis to OEGI’s research and stakeholder engagement on access to capital and the competitiveness of Ontario’s capital markets.

This role requires a high level of intellectual curiosity about emerging areas within capital markets and the growth economy, as well as a willingness to continually learn and apply legal, business and analytical expertise to find practical solutions to the regulatory challenges facing novel business models and growth companies. It is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for creative, challenging, and innovative work in the securities industry.

**What you will be doing:**

***Supporting Innovative Businesses and New Entrants through OSC LaunchPad and OSC TestLab***

* Engage with businesses submitting requests for support through OSC LaunchPad, ensuring appropriate review of applications and determining appropriate next steps, including analyzing regulatory frameworks to ensure that appropriate investor protections and safeguards are considered at all stages.

* Collaborate with businesses to understand their products, services and business models, and consult with subject matter experts in other OSC branches (e.g., Corporate Finance, Trading and Markets, Investment Management, and Registration, Inspections and Examinations), as needed, to identify solutions and potential risks, taking into consideration the mandate of the Commission and external business needs.

* Conduct legal analysis of novel issues and recommend opportunities to support responsible innovation and new market entrants, including through testing, exemptiverelief, time-limited registration and other flexible regulatory approaches, balancing business needs with regulatory objectives and investor protection.

* Support the design, delivery and evaluation of OSC TestLab tests, including initiatives that support early-stage capital raising, and assist in drafting related orders, decision documents, guidance and reporting.

* Support the development of guidance and education on the OSC’s regulatory environment, policies and practices, so that new businesses, investors and their advisors understand how to navigate prospectus, registration, compliance and marketplace requirements.

***Policy, Research and Commit*****tees**

* Support and, in some cases, lead the development and execution of policy initiatives that address capital-raising challenges along the private–public continuum, providing legal expertise and advice, managing project deliverables and timelines, resolving issues, and preparing briefing notes and status reports as required.

* Contribute legal and regulatory analysis to OEGI research on growth sectors, financing gaps, capital flows and equity markets, including comparisons with regulatory approaches in other jurisdictions, and help translate research findings into options for consultations, pilots, exemptions or rule changes.

* Keep abreast of, and inform team members, management and executives of, recent developments and emerging trends (domestically and internationally) that may impact Ontario’s capital markets, including identifying potential policy initiatives while ensuring investors are protected.

* With other team members, serve as an OSC representative on the CSA Financial Innovation Hub (CSA FinHub), including working groups, national testing initiatives and related research projects.

* Advocate for OSC views and work with other team members to negotiate effectively with the CSA, government and stakeholders and reach a resolution on contentious issues.

***Stakeholder Engagement and Relationship Management***

* Develop strong collaborative relationships across Ontario’s innovation and growth ecosystem, including early- and growth-stage founders and executives, angel investors and angel groups, venture and growth capital investors, innovation hubs, incubators and accelerators, industry and trade groups, lawyers and other professional advisors, academics and government, and provide guidance on securities regulation and its impact on business model development and capital raising.

* Support OEGI outreach, events, and consultations to gather stakeholder perspectives, raise awareness and adoption of OSC pilots and initiatives, and bring those insights into OSC policymaking.

* Develop relationships with stakeholders across the organization, including other OSC staff and management, to understand activities and concerns, provide advice and guidance, collaborate on files, and identify opportunities to challenge established approaches and practic**es.**

**What you need to succeed:**

* Post-graduate education in Law and LLB/JD designation in Canada.
* Member in good standing of the Law Society of Ontario.
* Minimum 5 years post-call to the Bar with experience gained in a law firm and/or regulatory role within the securities industry, including significant in-depth experience in securities regulation.
* Keen interest in emerging developments within capital markets and the growth economy, access to capital for early- and growth-stage businesses, and how technology and new business models can provide solutions for businesses and investors.
* Operational experience in a start-up or other innovative business, or experience advising early- and growth-stage companies or their investors, would be a strong asset.
* Strong research and analytical skills, including comfort working with data and evidence to support legal and policy analysis.
* Strong project management, strategic thinking and critical thinking skills.
* A demonstrated ability to make sound, practical business recommendations.
* Commitment to building positive working relationships and engaging with internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent ability to communicate (verbal and written) ideas clearly and concisely, including when delivering presentations and responding to questions.
* Self-motivated individual who can work in an agile team environment with minimal direction, prioritize multiple projects, assist others, and perform at a high level under pressure.

Title: Environmental Inspector (Construction)
Description:
PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team) is a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan, and Obayashi, supported by design partners Egis, Mott MacDonald, and Weston Williamson + Partners. Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Environmental Inspector is responsible for ensuring that all construction activities within the PACT program comply with applicable environmental regulations, project-specific environmental management plans, and industry best practices. This role plays a critical part in supporting sustainable construction practices while minimizing environmental impacts across project sites.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with federal, provincial, and municipal environmental regulations, as well as project permits and approvals.
* Monitor construction activities for adherence to Environmental Management Plans (EMPs), Erosion and Sediment Control (ESC) measures, and Spill Prevention Plans.
* Identify and document environmental risks, non-compliance issues, and potential impacts to soil, air, water, and wildlife.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports, including observations, deficiencies, corrective actions, and photographic records.
* Maintain accurate environmental logs, monitoring data, and regulatory documentation for audits and reporting requirements.
* Support internal and external environmental audits and regulatory inspections.
* Respond to environmental incidents (e.g., spills, unauthorized discharges, wildlife disturbances) and ensure proper containment, reporting, and remediation actions are implemented.
* Provide recommendations for corrective actions and follow-up to ensure resolution.
* Work closely with construction managers, subcontractors, engineers, and environmental consultants to promote compliance and environmental awareness.
* Communicate environmental requirements and site expectations to field teams and subcontractors.
* Liaise with regulatory agencies as required.
* Promote sustainable construction practices, waste reduction, and pollution prevention initiatives.
* Monitor waste management processes, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous materials.
* Support with environmental training and toolbox talks for site personnel.
* Support with other duties as needed.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Your work schedule will be during site hours. Flexibility to work nights and weekends, as required by the construction schedule, is expected. Any schedule changes or on-call requirements will be managed in accordance with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company.

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Diploma or degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or related discipline.
* Certified Environmental Professional (CEP) or similar designation is considered an asset.
* Erosion & Sediment Control certification is considered an asset.
* 3-5+ years of environmental inspection experience, preferably in construction, infrastructure, or large-scale development projects.
* Strong knowledge of Ontario environmental regulations and guidelines (e.g., MECP standards, ECA requirements).
* Experience with carbon reporting frameworks or sustainability programs is an asset.
* Experience with large infrastructure or transportation projects is an asset.
* Experience conducting environmental monitoring, inspections, and audits.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, and manage documentation.
* Proactive problem‑solver with strong organizational skills.

  

*PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.*

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description:
Requisition ID: 278493
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Scotiabank continues to be an industry leader for Payment’s technology and innovation. We have a history of safely leveraging new tools to enable new experiences for our customers, focusing on ensuring we protect their interests and goals. The result of this leads to modernization programs which aim to offer enriched information and transparencies to support the rapidly evolving payments community.

  

**The Role**

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will serve as the crucial bridge between our enterprise Artificial Intelligence platforms and our workforce. You will drive the adoption, effective utilization, and value realization of generative AI and intelligent productivity tools across the organization.

This is a highly strategic and user-centric role. You will not be responsible for coding, model training, or backend engineering. Instead, your focus will be on human-centric AI adoption: ensuring our teams know how to use these technologies, understand their evolving capabilities, and integrate them seamlessly into their daily workflows to maximize business value.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

User Onboarding & Adoption

* Design and execute comprehensive onboarding programs to introduce employees to enterprise AI tools.
* Develop user guides, technical manuals, and structured documentation to support system usage and knowledge transfer.
* Develop role-specific use cases and quick-start guides to help new users overcome initial learning curves.
* Partner with department heads to identify specific workflows that can benefit from AI integration.
* Analyze and create business workflows to improve efficiency and align them with new technology adoption initiatives.
* Lead structured information gathering sessions with stakeholders to identify business needs and opportunities for AI-driven workflow improvements.

  

Capabilities Roadmap & Strategy

* Monitor the evolving landscape of enterprise AI platforms and stay informed on upcoming feature releases.
* Translate vendor roadmaps into internal, business-focused capability roadmaps.
* Assess how new features align with business objectives and communicate these updates to the wider organization.

  

User Training & Education

* Create and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and webinars tailored to various technical proficiency levels.
* Develop best-practice resources, such as advanced prompt engineering libraries and functional workflow templates.
* Establish and manage a community of "AI Champions" across different departments to foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support end-to-end platform delivery by ensuring users are equipped to adopt new tools through structured enablement and guided usage practices.
* Support the delivery and rollout of new platforms, ensuring smooth transition from implementation to user adoption.

  

User Support & Feedback Loop

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for user questions, best-practice inquiries, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Triage technical bugs or system outages to the core technical engineering/IT teams.
* Gather, synthesize, and advocate for user feedback to shape future AI rollouts and training initiatives.
* Continuously improve workflows and user experience based on feedback gathered during post-implementation support.
* Perform functional validation and testing to ensure solutions align with business requirements and deliver expected user outcomes.

  

Value Realization & Metrics

* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to AI adoption, active usage, and user sentiment.
* Conduct surveys and interviews to measure time saved, productivity gains, and overall ROI of AI initiatives.
* Identify, document, and share internal success stories to drive continued engagement and demonstrate tangible business value.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology delivery, architecture, digital transformation, AI enablement or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading complex technology initiatives across cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery and modern engineering practices.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI or AI-assisted technologies to software engineering, testing, automation or technology operations.
* Understanding of LLMs, Generative AI and emerging AI capabilities, with the ability to translate them into practical technology solutions.
* Experience moving technology initiatives from discovery or proof of concept into implementation and adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Architecture, Business, Risk and other groups.
* Strong continuous-improvement mindset with demonstrated ability to coach teams and drive adoption of new technology.
* Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a related discipline.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Proven experience in technology enablement, change management, customer success, or digital transformation roles.
* **Tech Fluency:** Strong conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise productivity suites. No coding or backend development experience is required.
* **Adaptability:** Highly agile and capable of quickly learning new software platforms as our AI toolset evolves.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technological concepts into simple, business-friendly language.
* **Empathy:** A user-first mindset with a strong ability to understand and address the frustrations, fears, or hurdles employees face when adopting disruptive technologies.
* **Analytical:** Ability to track metrics, interpret data adoption, and build reports demonstrating business impact.
* 5-7 years of experience working in a similar capacity as a BA/BSA
* Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, Information sciences or another related field
* Fluency in Spanish (Nice to Have).
* Experience defining and measuring productivity and operational benefits from AI.

  

**What's in it for you?**

This role offers exposure to a wide range of technologies, problem domains, and stakeholders.

Title: Cybersecurity Consultant
Description:
**Location:** Doha, Qatar

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant to deliver both hands-on security operations and expert advisory services to the organization and its clients. The role combines security monitoring, detection, incident response, threat analysis, and vulnerability coordination with cybersecurity consultancy, including security assessments, risk and compliance advisory, security architecture, and strategic roadmap development. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, identity security, cloud security, threat intelligence, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).

This role will support and strengthen security operations capabilities, lead complex security incidents and assessments, translate technical findings into clear business-focused recommendations, and work closely with clients, Infrastructure, Development, IT Operations, and management to reduce cyber risk, achieve regulatory compliance, and improve overall security maturity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SOC Operations & Security Monitoring:

· Support and, where required, lead day-to-day SOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, escalation, and response.

· Design, establish, and maintain SOC processes, operating procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, and shift models for the organization and its clients.

· Monitor security events across endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud environments, applications, and security appliances.

· Ensure security alerts are investigated within defined priorities and response targets, with appropriate evidence and documentation.

· Continuously improve SOC workflows to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and increase analyst efficiency.

2. SIEM, EDR/XDR & Security Tooling:

· Design, implement, and optimize SIEM operations, including log onboarding, normalization, correlation rules, dashboards, alerting, and retention.

· Configure and optimize EDR/XDR capabilities for endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

· Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected from firewalls, network devices, servers, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, and critical systems.

· Evaluate security tooling and provide vendor-neutral recommendations to improve detection, investigation, automation, and response capabilities.

· Develop and maintain security monitoring use cases aligned with business risks, threat intelligence, and emerging attack techniques.

3. Incident Response & Threat Management:

· Lead the investigation and response to high-severity cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, account compromise, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

· Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client representatives.

· Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and completed.

· Develop, maintain, and facilitate testing of incident response plans, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

· Support digital forensics and evidence preservation activities, engaging specialist resources when required.

4. Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting:

· Establish threat intelligence processes to identify relevant threats, indicators of compromise, vulnerabilities, and attacker tactics.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.
