Title: URBN Senior Software Engineer
Description:
Role Summary:

URBN is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud-native services that power our digital ecosystem. We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who has taken complex systems from concept through production, architected the solution, rallied a team around it, and seen it through to a reliable, measurable outcome. You will own outcomes and be accountable for delivery timelines as much as the technology. You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of designers, data scientists, product managers, and domain experts to deliver significant business impact.

Role Responsibilities:

* Design and own RESTful web services and APIs using frameworks such as Tornado, or similar technologies, including GraphQL where appropriate.
* Architect asynchronous, event-driven systems and data pipelines, including consumer/producer patterns, batching strategies, error handling, and dead-letter/failure recovery flows.
* Design, build, and deploy containerized and serverless workloads on public cloud platforms, using cloud-native services where they fit.
* Define and manage infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) to keep environments reproducible, version-controlled, and auditable.
* Design data storage schemas, indexing strategies, and query optimization for high-throughput transactional workloads, and design caching layers where low-latency reads are required.
* Integrate AI/ML services and agentic workflows into backend systems using modern orchestration frameworks and event-driven patterns, including agentic harnesses (orchestration, tool access, context management, guardrails, and evaluation loops) and AI telemetry (model and tool call traces, token usage and cost, latency, and output quality) to run and improve them reliably in production.
* Own a comprehensive test strategy across unit, integration, behavior-driven, and performance/load testing; practice TDD and maintain high coverage standards.
* Own performance and resiliency: define and meet targets for latency, throughput, and availability; build in redundancy and graceful degradation.
* Apply SRE practices: observability (structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health checks), alerting, capacity planning, and deployment/release engineering through CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish engineering standards: static analysis, type checking, automated quality gates, and code review practices.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (design, coding, testing, code review, documentation, deployment, and incident analysis), and define team practices for it, such as context management, reusable agent instructions and skills, and human review of AI-generated code, while measuring its impact on quality and delivery speed.
* Own the technical roadmap for your area end-to-end: scope, sequence, and deliver major initiatives from design through production rollout, balancing technical debt against feature velocity.
* Participate in cross-functional planning with product, operations, and other engineering teams to align technical work with business priorities and deadlines.
* Conduct exploratory proof-of-concept studies to evaluate new architectures and technologies.
* Mentor engineering team members and champion engineering best practices.
* Participate in on-call support and incident response; diagnose issues across API, database, and cloud infrastructure layers, and drive post-incident follow-through.

Role Qualifications:

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a role with direct ownership of project delivery (technical lead, engineering manager, or senior IC accountable for outcomes, not just code).
* Demonstrated track record of taking at least one significant system or platform from design through production launch, including the tradeoffs, setbacks, and cross-team coordination involved.
* Expert-level backend engineering in a modern, high-performance language/framework ecosystem, with strong command of asynchronous programming patterns.
* RESTful APIs & Distributed Systems: Strong background in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs and distributed systems, including microservices architecture and high availability.
* Containerization & Cloud: Proficiency with Docker and experience deploying and operating applications on major public cloud platforms. Experience with serverless workloads, container orchestration (deployments, configuration/secrets management, autoscaling, resource tuning), and cloud-native services.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience defining and managing infrastructure using Terraform or similar tools.
* Database Management: Deep experience with production-grade relational data stores, including schema/data modeling, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, replication, and query optimization at scale.
* Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Experience with distributed messaging/event-streaming systems, including consumer group management, batch processing, error handling, and partition/scaling management.
* Quality & Automation: Dedication to modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines, Test-Driven Development (TDD), comprehensive testing (unit, integration, behavior-driven, performance/load), and automated code quality standards.
* AI-Augmented Development: Proficient in using AI-powered development tools (e.g., Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, or Gemini) across the development lifecycle, from coding and testing to design documentation and code review, with sound judgment in validating AI-generated output for correctness, security, and protection of proprietary code and data.

Benefits include medical, dental, vision, PTO, generous employee discounts, retirement savings and much more! For additional information visit www.urbn.com/work-with-us/benefits

Serves as the national Land Management Radio lead for Law Enforcement and Investigations within the Forest Service Chief Information Office (CIO), providing leadership and oversight of mission-critical communications systems. Manages acquisitions, contracts, lifecycle planning, policy development, and implementation of secure nationwide P25 and encrypted communications.

Title: Transportation Supervisor
Description:
**Welcome to Waste Resource Management (WRM)**
----------------------------------------------

At Waste Resource Management (WRM), we go beyond operating trucks —we are dedicated to environmental protection and delivering exceptional service. With a presence across Texas, Colorado, Florida, and Nevada, our *affiliated companies*—**SouthWaste Disposal LLC, Silver City Processing, and McDonald Farms, Inc.—**offer comprehensive solutions for liquid waste recycling and transportation.

**Join a Company That Values You**
----------------------------------

At WRM and affiliated companies, your work matters—for the environment, our clients, and your career. If you’re ready to drive for a company that **pays well, offers a competitive benefits package, operates safely, and supports your growth**, we want to hear from you.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Transportation Supervisor,** reporting to the General Manager, oversees daily fleet operations to support safe, efficient, and timely customer service. This role works with dispatch, drivers, customers, and the operations team to coordinate routes, equipment, and material transportation, resolve service issues, and maintain compliance with company safety policies and transportation regulations. The role spends approximately 80% of its time in the field and 20% in the office on administrative and planning responsibilities.

  

**Why join WRM and affiliated companies?**
------------------------------------------

* **Competitive Hourly Pay:** Market-basedpay with annual performance reviews and pay increases based on company and individual performance.
* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Choose from one of three medical plans, based on your needs, dental, and vision coverage; along with a 401(k) with a 5% company match
* **Career Growth**: Training programs and advancement opportunities in wastewater operations and environmental services
* **Paid Time Off:** Generous PTO policy accrues from day 1, with floating and company-paid holidays.
* **Additional Perks:** Company-paid life and disability insurance, employee assistance program, and more
* **Supportive Leadership:** Leadership that values safety, professionalism, and growth

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

* Coordinate with dispatch to prepare daily routes and work orders in routing software. Use dispatch portals, radios, and phones to communicate assignments and schedule changes.
* Determine staffing, vehicle, equipment, and material needs based on work orders and customer requirements. Monitor driver locations and equipment utilization to adjust schedules as needed.
* Manage routes and driver hours to help drivers meet daily gallons-per-hour (GPH) targets while complying with Hours of Service (HOS) requirements.
* Monitor compliance with U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and company safety policies. Conduct weekly safety meetings, route observations, and ride-alongs to reinforce safe work practices and monitor performance.
* Respond to vehicle breakdowns, service interruptions, and other operational issues. Coordinate solutions to minimize delays and complete scheduled service.
* Address customer questions, service and equipment requests, and escalated concerns. Request feedback, provide manifests upon request, and contact cash-on-delivery (COD) customers to schedule service.
* Maintain records of customer requests, completed work, and dispatch activity. Record mileage from drivers’ daily route sheets and use plant data to report service volumes, daily accidents, and driver hours of service to management.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What You Need:**
------------------

* At least two years of dispatch experience, preferably in waste management or transportation.
* High school diploma or equivalent. Training or certification in logistics or transportation management preferred.
* One to two years of experience using Microsoft Excel and Word. Intermediate to advanced proficiency preferred.
* Experience coordinating or overseeing transportation routes.
* At least one year of customer service experience.
* At least one year of experience reporting financial information to senior management.
* Class A commercial driver’s license (CDL) with a tanker endorsement (preferred).
* Grease trap cleaning experience (preferred).
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (preferred).
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, troubleshoot problems, and work independently and as part of a team.

  

Equal Employment

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to equal treatment of all employees without regard to race, national origin, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or other basis protected by law.

WRM complies with the ADA and considers reasonable accommodation measures that may be necessary for eligible applicants/employees to perform essential functions.

Our Office Operations team is at the heart of ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the Firm’s day-to-day operations. * Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4, PMP, COBIT, ISO 20000 or other IT Service Management certifications will be an advantage.
* Experience working in large enterprise, government or regulated environments will be preferred.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**

A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.

The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.

The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.

Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

Maxan is looking for an organized and proactive Project Coordinator to support our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys coordinating multiple moving parts, and takes pride in delivering projects with precision and professionalism.

  

Reporting to the Manager, Project Management Operations, you’ll be part of Maxan’s Project Management Team (PMT), working closely with Safety, Purchasing, Field Operations, and Estimating to plan, communicate, execute, and document day-to-day project activities. You’ll play a key role in ensuring projects run smoothly, meet client expectations, and uphold Maxan’s industry reputation for superior craftsmanship and service, helping us build lasting relationships with our customers.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Prepare and maintain three- and six-week look-ahead schedules, production trackers and milestone dates, and review General Contractor schedules for impacts to our scope.
* Verify field progress, compare it with plan, and flag slippage, sequencing conflicts and delay risks early.
* Support Site Superintendents with daily and weekly field plans, crew scheduling, area readiness and manpower forecasting.
* Maintain a schedule-constraint log, follow up on open items and escalate unresolved issues to the Project Manager.
* Issue concise weekly status reports and prepare recovery plans and schedule narratives as needed.
* Track RFIs, submittals, drawings, procurement, changes, delays, deficiencies and closeout through current project-control logs.
* Coordinate material requirements, deliveries and long-lead items with suppliers and the field.
* Compile backup for change orders, delay notices and progress billing.
* Attend project meetings, issue minutes and action lists, and follow up on commitments.
* Keep project files organized and support closeout, turnover and continuous-improvement efforts.

  

**What You Bring:**

* Post-secondary education in Construction Management, Project Management, Construction Engineering Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in construction, ideally in a project coordination or project management capacity.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and documentation management skills.
* Proficiency in MS projects, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with office, field and external stakeholders.
* Valid driver’s license and access to reliable transportation to visit job sites.
* Experience with a commercial drywall, acoustic ceiling, interior systems or specialty trade contractor is considered an asset.
* Experience preparing look-ahead schedules, production trackers, manpower forecasts and recovery plans is considered an asset.
* Experience with Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud and Bluebeam Revu is considered an asset.
* Experience supporting change orders, delay notices, procurement, labour tracking, billing and project closeout is considered an asset.

  

**What’s In It For You:**

* Competitive compensation package, including a structured KPI Bonus Program
* Excellent benefits and annual health spending account
* Great vacation policy plus 3 paid personal days
* RRSP Matching Program
* Early office closure on Fridays throughout the year and summer hours
* Complimentary use of our gym and shower facilities on-site
* Fresh fruit and snacks around the office
* In-house leadership and development programs through Maxan Academy
* Be part of an amazing culture where you want to come to work!

  

If you’re passionate about construction, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to contribute to exciting projects, we’d love to hear from you!

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Responsibilities**

* Supervise a team of network analyst to provide superior customer service through effective leadership, documentation, training, and coaching techniques.
* Provide exceptional customer service by possessing strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ensure NOC Analysts are properly trained and adhere to company policies associated with monitoring the network, proper call handling techniques, and best practice troubleshooting skills.
* Work closely with the field engineering and engineering teams in support of installations, provisioning, troubleshooting, and repair of the network following good engineering practices with a primary focus of network reliability.

Title: IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander
Description:
**Title – IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander**

**Location – Remote - Partial Travel**

The Major Incident Manager (MIM) for a Healthcare IT Enterprise Operations Center (EOC) is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the end-to-end management of critical IT service disruptions that affect patient care, clinical workflows, and hospital operations. This is senior level, decision authority role within Core Tech, responsible for leading enterprise-level, Tier 1 incidents across the healthcare environment. This role goes beyond traditional incident coordination and requires command authority, strong executive communication, and deep understanding of healthcare IT operations, including infrastructure, networking, clinical imaging, and EHR access. This role exists because the current incident model is not meeting enterprise needs and requires experienced leadership to reset and stabilize Tier 1 incident response across multiple facilities.

This role is accountable for incident outcomes, not coordination alone. Candidates should be vetted for sound judgement, executive level communication and styles, and ability to lead people.

**Role Summary**

The Major Incident Manager acts as the "Incident Commander," (single point of command) driving the swift restoration of critical healthcare services (e.g., EHR access, diagnostic imaging, and network connectivity) while maintaining transparent communication with executive leadership and clinical stakeholders. This role is responsible for incident outcomes, not just processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Command & Coordination:**

* Lead the Major Incident Bridge by facilitating 24/7 technical bridge calls and "war rooms" to triage and resolve Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) incidents impacting multiple health ministries or systems.
* MIM impact to multiple facilities, wider user impacts, or multiple technology failures.
* Lead real‑time decision‑making under pressure, balancing technical recovery with patient‑safety and clinical impact.
* Resources will not typically be responsible for concurrent major incident ownership

**Clinical Impact Assessment:**

* Quickly evaluate the scope of technical outages to determine their impact on patient safety and critical business applications.
* Outages may impact EHR systems, Clinical Imaging, Network dependencies, as examples.
* Identify trends, anomalies, and recurring failure patterns

**Stakeholder Communication:**

* Issue regular, clear updates to senior leadership (CIO/CTO) and Service Portfolio leads using pre-defined communication templates and protocols.
* Maintain confidence and calm in high‑pressure situations with senior leaders and clinical partners.

**Post-Incident Management:**

* Own and facilitate after action reports and Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) within 48 hours to identify root causes and drive preventive actions.
* Conduct root cause discussions and ensure corrective actions are identified and tracked.
* Communication and stakeholder management are the number‑one success factor for this role and is treated as top priority for candidate review.

**Process Improvement:**

* Own and continuously optimize the enterprise incident management process in alignment with ITIL best practices and healthcare regulatory requirements.

**Vendor & Matrix Management:**

* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal cross-functional teams (Network, Security, Clinical Apps) to ensure rapid service recovery.

**Monitoring and Alerting:**

* Utilize AIOps, triaging and monitoring tools, dashboards, and alerting systems across on-premise and cloud environments (e.g. SolarWinds, NetPath, ScienceLogic) to assist with MTTD and MTTR.

**Incident Response:**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex operational incidents, guiding technical teams to swift and effective resolution for critical monitoring issues.

**Performance Optimization:**

* Analyze monitoring data and performance metrics (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, Incident Recurrence Rate, SLA Compliance) to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues, providing recommendations for improvement and capacity planning.

**Automation:**

* Identify and implement automation opportunities for major incident management and routine tasks to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

**Collaboration and Documentation:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Application, Network, Security, Cloud Enablement, Managed Service Provider, etc.) to maintain Major Incident Management comprehensive documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks.

**Problem Management:**

* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews to prevent recurring issues and drive long-term solutions.

**Compliance and Security:**

* Ensure MIB processes comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC, HIPAA).

**Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive IT operations or enterprise support experience.
* 5-7+ years in IT major incident management or IT service management, with specific experience in healthcare environments and enterprise operations centers.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, 5-7 years of technical experience in one or more of the following areas - Networking, Clinical Imaging devices and applications and EHR access fundamentals. Infrastructure experience is non-negotiable; candidates that worked MIMs without background in infrastructure will not be a fit. For example: prior Epic‑only or application‑only backgrounds without infrastructure experience will not meet requirements.
* Strong understanding of HIPAA and HITECH compliance regarding protected health information (PHI).
* Proven track record in managing large-scale, network or operations center with complex operations.
* In-depth knowledge of enterprise network architecture, data center operations, cloud environments, and relevant software/tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, Solar/Winds, SendWordNow, ServiceNow).

Soft skills are the first priority in candidate review-

* Excellent crisis leadership and decision-making abilities under pressure.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and performance metrics to drive strategic decisions.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effective collaboration with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with a focus on details and time management.

**Education and Certifications:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an MBA or a related Master's degree is highly preferred.
* Preferred Qualifications and Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience with industry-standard monitoring and observability tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, SolarWinds).

**Work Environment**

* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* May require off-hours work or participation in an on-call rotation to support operations.
* Travel requirements may include quarterly onsite business meetings and occasional travel abroad for vendor relationship management.
* This role often operates in a dynamic, fast-paced, remote operations center and may require working irregular hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to help manage critical incidents and service delivery escalations.

**Top 3 Priorities for this role:**

1. Stakeholder Communication and personality fit
2. Technical Depth (infrastructure centric)
3. Relevant Senior Level Leadership Experience – not just years of experience but depth of what candidate has actually done in career

**Interview process – panel, 2 rounds**

**Round 1:**
Fit, personality, communication, leadership presence (Priority #1)

**Round 2:**
Technical and experiential depth (Priorities #2 and #3)

**Comments for Suppliers:**
A key concern is that candidates have flexibility in hours that they are available to work - the most common shift will be 2 pm to 10 pm Central time. Flexibility in working hours will be an advantage and such candidates will be preferred. Please include candidate availability in the supplier comments section of candidate submittal, as well as on top of resume.

**Education**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or relevant field

**Work Environment**

The City of Toronto is seeking a strategic and accomplished leader to serve as Senior Director, Community Recreation.

**Head of Engineering Job Description:** Scope, Impact & Qualifications Reports to: CEO Level: Executive (CTO-equivalent scope) Org size: ~25 engineers Time split: 70% Product / 30% Discipline ROLE SUMMARY The Head of Engineering owns the technical outcomes of Maestro's entire product suite while also serving as the top of the engineering discipline ladder: every engineering manager and individual contributor ultimately ladders up to this role. The position deliberately splits attention: 70% product execution, 30% discipline accountability. Product delivery is the immediate, ongoing accountability; discipline work compounds over time and requires protected but smaller blocks of focus so it doesn't get crowded out by delivery pressure. This role sits at the center of Maestro's matrix structure, accountable for craft quality and standards company-wide, while ensuring embedded engineering talent on each product team is pointed at the right priorities.
  
  
**SCOPE • Org reach:** all engineering leads across all product lines report into this role (directly or via a lead layer), the senior-most engineering accountability in the company. • Product surface: full product suite, every active product line's engineering output. • Discipline surface: engineering-wide standards, tooling, and process, independent of which product team an engineer sits on. THE 70%: PRODUCT ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering is the single accountable owner for engineering execution across Maestro's product portfolio.
  
  
**What this looks like day to day:** • Partners with the engineering leads of every product line to ensure their teams are resourced against the right priorities: not just busy, but correctly sequenced. • Accountable for ensuring product strategy and roadmap direction are translated into clear, actionable engineering plans, serving as the connective layer between Product and Delivery leadership and the engineering organization, primarily through engineering leads embedded within product teams. • Accountable for applying technical judgment to turn high-level strategic priorities into concrete technical execution plans, enabling and guiding engineering leads to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery across their product areas. • Identifies where product priorities and engineering capacity are misaligned across teams and resolves the tradeoff, including cross-team resourcing calls.
  
  

* Is the escalation point when a product line's engineering execution is off track, and is accountable for getting it back on track. Impact: Every product line ships against strategy, not just against what's easiest to build. Product and Delivery leaders have one accountable engineering partner instead of negotiating separately with each product line's lead. THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line.

**What this looks like day to day:** • Sets and maintains company-wide engineering standards (code quality, architecture principles, technical debt posture). • Owns cross-cutting technical initiatives that no single product team should solve independently, e.g. product suite services and universal QA automation. • Defines how AI tooling is used across engineering, including guardrails to ensure AI usage improves output quality and velocity rather than introducing risk or degrading craft.
  
  

* Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day-to-day people management is embedded in product teams. Impact: Engineering quality, velocity, and management practice don't fragment by product line. An engineer's experience of "how we build software here" is consistent no matter which team they're on, and the org gets the benefits of scale (shared tooling, shared standards) instead of each team reinventing its own.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Engineers across the organization deliver flawless technical execution that earns long-term client retention and supports growth. • Product lines are resourced against strategic priority, with tradeoffs made explicitly rather than by default. • Engineering leads across product lines operate with a shared technical bar and shared tooling. • Company-wide initiatives (QA automation, AI usage standards) ship and get adopted, not just get designed.
  
  

* Engineering management practice is consistent and healthy across the org, even though EMs are embedded in product teams day to day. QUALIFICATIONS Maestro hires for demonstrated capability, not years-of-service checkboxes. The bar below is competency-based: what someone needs to be able to do, not how long they've been doing it. Required competencies: • Has personally carried end-to-end accountability for engineering delivery across more than one product or team simultaneously: not just led a single team, but balanced competing priorities across several.
* Can translate ambiguous, high-level strategy (from product, business, or leadership) into a technical execution plan that engineers can actually build against, without needing someone else to do that translation. • Has designed or materially improved an engineering standard, process, or tooling investment that worked across teams (not a single-team fix) and can point to the before/after. • Comfortably operates in a matrixed environment, influencing and aligning engineering leads, their teams, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. • Has hands-on technical depth sufficient to earn credibility with senior engineers and to personally evaluate technical tradeoffs.

This is not a purely managerial role. • Has direct experience managing or mentoring engineering managers, not only individual contributors. • Demonstrates sound judgment on when to standardize company-wide versus when to let product teams operate with autonomy. Strongly preferred: • Experience operating at this scope inside a company of comparable size (roughly 15 to 50 engineers), where formal process is lighter and judgment calls happen more often than policy lookups.
  
  

* Direct experience setting a company's approach to AI-assisted engineering (tooling choices, guardrails, or usage standards) rather than just using AI tools personally. • A track record of building or scaling QA automation, testing strategy, or release process across multiple teams. • Experience partnering directly with Product and Delivery leadership as a peer, not just receiving requirements from them. • Experience leading engineering for always-on, customer-facing digital products or live-service platforms, where availability, release discipline, observability, incident response, and rapid cross-functional coordination directly affect the end-user experience and client retention.

**What we're explicitly not requiring:** • A specific prior title (VP Engineering, CTO, etc.). We care about scope actually carried, not the title it came with. • A minimum years-of-experience threshold. Competency and evidence of impact matter more than tenure.
  
  

* Deep expertise in every technology in Maestro's stack. Technical judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs matter more than hands-on fluency in any one language or framework.

-------------------------

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate is an experienced behavioral health leader with expertise in overseeing comprehensive children’s and youth mental health and substance use disorder services. They possess strong knowledge of integrated behavioral health care, Medi-Cal, evidence-based practices, and the regulatory and operational requirements of public behavioral health systems.

The successful candidate is a strategic, forward-thinking leader who can advance the integration of mental health and substance use disorder treatment, strengthen coordination across the continuum of care, and improve outcomes for children and youth with complex and co-occurring needs. They excel at leading multidisciplinary teams, building collaborative partnerships, and using data to drive quality and performance. Strong leadership, communication, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with a commitment to person-centered, recovery-oriented care.

  
  
**TENTATIVE RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE**

**Application Deadline**: December 8, 2026

**Oral Examination**: Tentatively the week of December 14, 2026

  
  

To learn more about BHRS opportunities, visit www.stancounty.com/bhrs/

  
  
**THE POSITION**

The Chief of Children’s Services is a member of the Behavioral Health and Recovery Services (BHRS) Senior Leadership Team and reports to the Assistant Director. This position provides leadership and strategic direction for the Department’s continuum of child and youth mental health and substance use disorder services. The Chief leads the Children’s Services Division, with a strong focus on advancing integrated treatment and strengthening coordination across mental health and substance use disorder programs.

The Chief is responsible for overseeing the Division’s programs, operations, and strategic direction while advancing a comprehensive, person-centered system of care for children and youth with behavioral health needs, including individuals with complex and co-occurring mental health and substance use conditions. The position collaborates with executive leadership, community providers, healthcare partners, and other system partners to improve access, strengthen care coordination, reduce service fragmentation, and promote quality outcomes across the behavioral health continuum.

**Division Overview**

The Children’s Services Division is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of comprehensive mental health and substance use treatment services for children and youth throughout Stanislaus County. The Division supports a broad continuum of care designed to meet individuals at varying levels of behavioral health need and promote recovery, stability, and community well-being.

A central focus of the Division is advancing the integration of mental health and substance use disorder treatment to better serve individuals with complex and co-occurring conditions. The Division works to strengthen coordination across programs, improve transitions between levels of care, and reduce fragmentation within the behavioral health system. Through collaboration with other County programs, contracted providers, healthcare partners, and community organizations, Children’s Services works to create a more connected and responsive continuum of behavioral health care.

  
  
**Questions? We're Here to Help!**
  
If you are interested in learning more about this opportunity, the recruitment process, or need assistance with your application, please contact the **Behavioral Health and Recovery Services Recruitment Team at (209) 525-6112 or****recruitments****@****stanbhrs.org****.**

**Typical Tasks**
-----------------

* Provide leadership and strategic direction for the Children’s Services Division and its continuum of mental health and substance use treatment services.
* Lead efforts to integrate mental health and substance use disorder treatment, with particular focus on improving services for individuals with co-occurring conditions.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve access, engagement, care coordination, transitions between levels of care, and continuity of behavioral health services.
* Oversee the planning, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of children’s behavioral health programs and services.
* Ensure programs operate in accordance with Specialty Mental Health Services and DMC-ODS requirements, Medi-Cal regulations, Department policies, and established standards of care.
* Analyze utilization, access, quality, and outcome data to identify service gaps, evaluate program performance, and guide system improvements.
* Collaborate with other Systems of Care, managed care plans, healthcare partners, contracted providers, social service partners, and community organizations to strengthen the children’s behavioral health continuum.
* Provide leadership and oversight to managers and multidisciplinary teams; motivate, coach, and support staff in achieving Department and Division goals.
* Lead organizational and practice changes necessary to support integrated, person-centered, recovery-oriented, and evidence-based care.
* Participate in the development and monitoring of the Department’s budget and ensure effective stewardship of resources supporting the Children’s Services Division.
* Develop policies, procedures, and operational practices consistent with applicable regulatory and program requirements.
* Prepare and deliver presentations, reports, Board agenda items, and responses to stakeholder and community inquiries.
* Lead and support responses to system- and program-level crises, operational challenges, and emerging community needs.
* Collaborate as a member of the BHRS Senior Leadership Team to advance Department-wide strategic priorities and uphold the vision, mission, and values of BHRS and Stanislaus County.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education/Experience)**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**KNOWLEDGE**

* Children’s behavioral health treatment systems, including mental health and substance use treatment services;
* Medi-Cal behavioral health delivery systems, including Specialty Mental Health Services (SMHS) and the Drug Medi-Cal Organized Delivery System (DMC-ODS);
* Principles and practices of integrated mental health and substance use disorder treatment, including services for individuals with co-occurring conditions;
* Evidence-based, person-centered, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-oriented behavioral health practices;
* Medi-Cal managed care, behavioral health financing, reimbursement, documentation, and compliance requirements;
* Current federal and state laws, regulations, and policy developments affecting public behavioral health systems;
* Principles of consumer and family engagement, peer support, recovery, and community-based care;
* Social determinants impacting behavioral health outcomes, including housing, healthcare access, justice involvement, and other community and family needs; and
* Principles of organizational leadership, program development, quality improvement, performance management, and fiscal stewardship.

**SKILLS/ABILITIES**

* Translate the Department’s vision, mission, values, and strategic priorities into effective operational plans and measurable outcomes;
* Lead and advance an integrated system of children and youth mental health and substance use disorder services, including services for individuals with co-occurring conditions;
* Operationalize system-of-care and cross-system approaches that improve access, coordination, transitions, and continuity of care;
* Provide effective leadership and oversight of complex public behavioral health programs, including Specialty Mental Health Services and DMC-ODS;
* Anticipate and respond effectively to changes in Medi-Cal, funding, legislation, regulations, and behavioral health policy;
* Analyze complex administrative, clinical, fiscal, and operational issues and develop effective solutions;
* Lead organizational and system change while identifying opportunities to improve quality, access, efficiency, and outcomes;
* Motivate, coach, develop, and support managers and staff while effectively delegating responsibility and maintaining accountability;
* Build effective partnerships with consumers and families, community organizations, healthcare partners, managed care plans, contracted providers, and other governmental agencies;
* Facilitate collaboration across programs and systems to address complex behavioral health and community needs;
* Communicate effectively with diverse audiences and prepare clear, comprehensive, and professional written reports, presentations, correspondence, and recommendations;
* Organize and facilitate workgroups, committees, stakeholder meetings, and other collaborative planning efforts;
* Apply effective conflict resolution, negotiation, and problem-solving skills;
* Manage priorities and perform effectively in a complex, rapidly changing public behavioral health environment;
* Work independently and collaboratively as a member of the Department’s Senior Leadership Team; and
* Bilingual skills in English and Spanish are highly desirable.

  
**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**  

* Graduation from an accredited college or university with a master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, Counseling, or a related field; **AND**
* Possession of, or ability to obtain within eighteen (18) months of appointment, licensure in the State of California as a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC); **AND**
* Two (2) years of management experience comparable to a Stanislaus County Manager III; **OR**
* Four (4) years of progressively responsible management experience in behavioral health, healthcare administration, managed care, or a related public sector environment involving program administration, strategic planning, interagency collaboration, and organizational leadership.

  
Proof of licensure is required for verification purposes at the time of application. Applicants who are unable to submit proof must call (209) 525-6112 to make other arrangements before 5 pm on the final filing date. Failure to submit proof or make other arrangements before the final filing date deadline will result in disqualification.
  
  
**DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS**
  
In addition to the minimum qualifications, applicant screening may focus on the following desirable qualifications. Please list this experience within the “Duties” section of the online application.  
  
  

* Current and active licensure in the State of California as a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC).

----------------------------------------

Applications cannot be submitted later than 5:00 p.m. on the final filing date. Make your online application as complete as possible so a full and realistic appraisal may be made of your qualifications.

* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. Meeting these demands will require more of Tides’ people practices: thoughtful organizational design, clear goals and performance expectations, modern, well-integrated systems, and a culture that helps staff adapt to change with confidence. Reporting to the Chief Legal and People Officer, the Vice President will be a trusted advisor to Tides’ senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, culture, change management, and JEDI principles and practices. The role also oversees HR business support for Tides Center’s fiscally sponsored projects and Tides’ workforce development, performance management, and staff safety and security. The Vice President will work closely with fellow senior leaders and department heads to ensure alignment between strategy and day-to-day needs and operations.

The Vice President will lead the People Team, with direct reports that include: the Director, Total Rewards & People Operations; the Director, Organization Development and People; and the Director, Tides Center People.

Title: Director of Commercial Shared Services
Description:
### **Job Purpose**

The Director of Commercial Shared Services leads the shared commercial capabilities that support Arabic AI Agents & Services verticals. The role is responsible for ensuring the effective integration and performance of Sales Development Representatives (SDR), Bidding, and Sales Operations, establishing consistent processes, governance, reporting, and service standards across the commercial pipeline. Working closely with the COO and the Heads of AI & Agents and Services, the Director translates commercial priorities into coordinated lead-generation, bid-management, and operational-support activities; improves pipeline visibility and execution; and enables the commercial teams to pursue opportunities efficiently, consistently, and in line with company objectives.

### **Shared Commercial Strategy & Governance**

* Translate the Commercial priorities into an integrated operating plan for SDR, Bidding, and Sales Operations, supporting both the AI & Agents and Services verticals.
* Establish shared commercial processes, standards, service levels, and ways of working that promote consistency while accommodating the distinct requirements of each vertical.
* Define clear ownership, handover points, and escalation routes across lead generation, opportunity qualification, bid/no-bid decisions, proposal development, CRM administration, and commercial reporting.

### **Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Heads and Managers within the shared commercial functions, setting clear expectations, priorities, and accountability.
* Agree function-level objectives and KPIs, review performance regularly, address gaps, and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Plan and allocate resources across SDR, Bidding, and Sales Operations according to agreed commercial priorities, workload, deadlines, and business needs.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a results-oriented culture across the shared services teams.

### **Sales Development & Pipeline Support**

* Oversee the SDR function’s lead-generation and prospecting plans, ensuring targeting, qualification criteria, outreach activity, and meeting generation align with the priorities of both commercial verticals.
* Define and oversee the SDR strategy, including lead-generation approaches, target-account prioritization, prospecting channels, and outreach strategies, ensuring alignment with the commercial and go-to-market objectives of both verticals.
* Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and automation within SDR activities to enhance lead identification, research, qualification, outreach personalization, and follow-ups, while automating routine tasks such as CRM updates, lead enrichment, and reporting to improve productivity, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure effective lead handover and feedback loops between SDR and the relevant AI & Agents or Services business development and account management teams.
* Review lead-generation and pipeline-contribution results with the Head of SDR, using data and market feedback to improve lead quality, conversion, and productivity, and continuously optimize SDR strategies, processes, AI utilization, and automation effectiveness against relevant performance KPIs.

### **Bidding & Proposal Management**

* Oversee the bidding function to ensure opportunities are assessed, prioritized, and managed through a disciplined bid lifecycle, from qualification and bid/no-bid decisions to submission and post-submission follow-up.
* Develop and oversee the bidding strategy, including opportunity prioritization, bid/no-bid decisions, resource allocation, and win strategies, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, GTM priorities, and market opportunities.
* Ensure bids and proposals are coordinated with the relevant vertical and subject-matter teams, are responsive to client requirements, and meet quality, compliance, commercial, and submission-deadline requirements.
* Position the Bidding function as a strategic business partner by engaging relevant functions, including Business Development, Presales, Product, Engineering, Production, Finance, Legal, and Marketing, early in the bid lifecycle to jointly shape opportunities, develop competitive proposals, and maximize win probability.
* Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and automation across the bidding lifecycle to improve opportunity assessment, RFP analysis, requirement mapping, proposal development, and content reuse, enhancing efficiency, quality, and scalability while maintaining appropriate accuracy and compliance controls.
* Monitor bid pipeline, submission schedules, win/loss outcomes, and lessons learned; use insights to strengthen bid strategy and proposal effectiveness.
* Escalate material bid risks, resource constraints, pricing or margin considerations, and approval requirements to the appropriate decision-makers.
* Build and continuously develop a scalable bidding and proposal management capability by strengthening team capacity, competencies, tools, and processes to support increasing bid volumes, complex opportunities, and the commercial growth of both verticals.

### **Sales Operations, CRM & Commercial Reporting**

* Oversee Sales Operations activities, including CRM governance, data quality, pipeline reporting, sales dashboards, forecasting support, commercial documentation, and process administration.
* Ensure commercial data, opportunity stages, activity records, and reporting definitions are consistent and reliable across the AI & Agents and Services verticals.
* Provide the COO and commercial leadership with timely analysis of pipeline health, lead conversion, bid performance, workload, and other relevant commercial KPIs.
* Develop and maintain a centralized Commercial Hub that supports both AI & Agents and Services while ensuring clear differentiation in their market positioning, value propositions, offerings, and commercial messaging.
* Oversee the maintenance of sales enablement materials, proposal and presentation templates, commercial collateral, and relevant records and workflows, ensuring the development of tailored presentations, sales decks, and marketing collateral that reflect the distinct value propositions and commercial priorities of each vertical while maintaining consistent corporate branding.
* Drive the effective use and continuous improvement of CRM platforms and other commercial tools, coordinating adoption, user guidance, and process changes as needed.
* Ensure the Commercial Hub operates as a strategic enabler for both verticals by facilitating access to commercial resources, standardizing best practices, and supporting the development and continuous improvement of sales enablement materials and tools.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with the Heads of AI & Agents and Services to understand their priorities, coordinate shared-function support, and resolve competing demands transparently.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, Marketing, Production, Technology, Products and other relevant teams to support forecasting, budgeting, proposal development, contract coordination, and compliant commercial execution.
* Maintain clear communication with stakeholders on priorities, capacity, deadlines, risks, performance, and required decisions.
* Ensure shared services support both verticals fairly and effectively, with priorities and resource allocation based on agreed business needs.

### **Process Improvement, Risk & Compliance**

* Document, maintain, and improve shared commercial workflows, policies, procedures, templates, and controls.
* Identify bottlenecks, duplication, data gaps, and operational risks across the commercial process, and implement improvements that increase efficiency and quality.
* Ensure activities within the shared commercial functions comply with company policies, approval authorities, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Promote the use of performance data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to continuously improve service quality and commercial outcomes.
* Carry out other duties necessary for the effective operation of the department.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Education, Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* 12-15 years of relevant experience across commercial operations, sales operations, bidding/proposal management, sales development, or related commercial functions, including substantial leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple teams or functions, setting performance expectations, and improving processes and operational effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of commercial pipelines, lead generation and qualification, bid management, CRM governance, sales reporting, and forecasting support.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, sales analytics and reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Familiarity with SDR, lead-generation, and bidding/proposal management platforms is an advantage.
* Experience in technology solutions and product companies is an advantage; experience in AI companies is a strong advantage.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
